about_the_game:
・Exciting train driving

A world where open tracks with various situations and a physically simulated driving sensation are connected.

・Physical simulation

It is not a system that runs on a predetermined line. The feature of this game is that the wheels actually roll and run on the rails.

・Settings and missions

You are a train driver supporting the growth of the emerging city-state "Chamland Republic" that is developing in the mountainous region. Complete missions and contribute to the development of the country.

・Cooperative system that loosely connects with others

Cooperate with other players through contribution points and achieve common goals.

・The demo version allows you to operate some areas and vehicles in offline mode.
